summary: At the Southern Guard Tower, Mountaineer Wallbang calls travelers to help defend Loch Modan from the Stonesplinter troggs. With Ironforge's reserves sent to distant fronts, the southern pass is thinly held. Wallbang sends seasoned recruits into Stonesplinter Valley to strike at the clan's shamans and bonesnappers.

sections.title: A Thin Dwarven Line
sections.body: Loch Modan's defenses are stretched thin. Ironforge's regular reserves have been summoned to distant fronts across Azeroth, leaving outposts such as the Southern Guard Tower short-handed. Mountaineer Wallbang and his few comrades face constant pressure from the Stonesplinter clan. They depend on Alliance travelers passing through to help hold the southern pass.

sections.title: Targeting the Stonesplinter Vanguard
sections.body: The fighting reaches beyond stray scouts to the Stonesplinter clan's strength. Its bonesnappers provide brutal force, while its shamans use earthen magic to rally their kin. Slaying twenty of these targets weakens the clan's incursions into the lowlands and serves King Magni Bronzebeard's defense of the realm.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Wallbang is an Ironforge dwarf stationed at the Southern Guard Tower in Loch Modan. He watches for troggs spilling out of the mountains and coordinates the militia to keep the main southern road secure.

faq.q: Why are the Mountaineers asking travelers for help?
faq.answer: Ironforge's military reserves have been called away to battlefronts across the kingdom and beyond. That leaves border outposts such as Loch Modan's southern watchtowers badly undermanned against local threats.
The Stonesplinter troggs gather in Stonesplinter Valley, in the rugged hills southwest of The Loch. Smaller bands of shamans and bonesnappers also haunt the northern islands in the lake.

faq.q: What makes the Stonesplinter clan a threat?
faq.answer: Troggs multiply rapidly and can overrun settled lands in subterranean swarms. Stonesplinter shamans wield crude elemental magic, while bonesnappers attack dwarven scouts, putting nearby settlements and trade paths at risk.

faq.q: What does Mountaineer Wallbang do after this task?
faq.answer: Wallbang is satisfied that you have proved yourself a fighter in King Magni's service. He sends you to report to Captain Rugelfuss for further orders in Loch Modan's defense.

faq.q: Who rules Ironforge during this crisis?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard rules the dwarven kingdom from the High Seat in Ironforge. Efforts to safeguard Loch Modan are made in his name and to defend his lands.

angles.text: As a dwarf, answering Wallbang's call means defending the homesteads of Loch Modan while your kin's standing armies are sent abroad.
As an Alliance traveler, helping the Southern Guard Tower protects vital trade and travel routes linking Dun Morogh to the eastern wetlands and Stormwind.
As a shaman, facing the Stonesplinter trogg spellcasters shows you crude earth magic shaped by savage instincts.
